mapper.select: SELECT c.checklist_id, c.department_id, c.checked_by, c.check_date, c.location, c.status, c.created_at, d.department_name, u.user_name AS checked_by_name, COUNT(i.item_id) AS item_count, SUM(CASE WHEN i.helmet_worn = 0 OR i.chin_strap_fastened = 0 OR i.is_damaged = 1 OR i.is_expired = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS violation_count FROM safety_checklist c LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = c.department_id JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = c.checked_by LEFT JOIN safety_check_item i ON i.checklist_id = c.checklist_id GROUP BY c.checklist_id ORDER BY c.check_date DESC, c.checklist_id DESC

SELECT c.checklist_id, c.department_id, c.checked_by, c.check_date, c.location, c.status, c.created_at, d.department_name, u.user_name AS checked_by_name FROM safety_checklist c LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = c.department_id JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = c.checked_by WHERE c.checklist_id = #{checklistId}

SELECT c.checklist_id, c.department_id, c.checked_by, c.check_date, c.location, c.status, c.created_at, d.department_name, u.user_name AS checked_by_name FROM safety_checklist c LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = c.department_id JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = c.checked_by WHERE c.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY c.checklist_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO safety_checklist (department_id, checked_by, check_date, location, status) VALUES (#{departmentId}, #{checkedBy}, #{checkDate}, #{location}, 'IN_PROGRESS')
mapper.update: UPDATE safety_checklist SET status = #{status} WHERE checklist_id = #{checklistId}
mapper.select: SELECT item_id, checklist_id, media_path, helmet_worn, chin_strap_fastened, is_damaged AS damaged, is_expired AS expired, detection_source, detection_boxes, memo, checked_at FROM safety_check_item WHERE checklist_id = #{checklistId} ORDER BY checked_at DESC, item_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO safety_check_item (checklist_id, media_path, helmet_worn, chin_strap_fastened, is_damaged, is_expired, detection_source, detection_boxes, memo) VALUES (#{checklistId}, #{mediaPath}, #{helmetWorn}, #{chinStrapFastened}, #{damaged}, #{expired}, #{detectionSource}, #{detectionBoxes}, #{memo})
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM safety_checklist WHERE check_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')) AS monthly_checklist_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM safety_checklist WHERE check_date = CURDATE()) AS today_checklist_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM safety_check_item i JOIN safety_checklist c ON c.checklist_id = i.checklist_id WHERE c.check_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')) AS monthly_item_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM safety_check_item i JOIN safety_checklist c ON c.checklist_id = i.checklist_id WHERE c.check_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND (i.helmet_worn = 0 OR i.chin_strap_fastened = 0 OR i.is_damaged = 1 OR i.is_expired = 1) ) AS monthly_fail_count

SELECT i.item_id, i.checklist_id, i.media_path, i.helmet_worn, i.chin_strap_fastened, i.is_damaged AS damaged, i.is_expired AS expired, i.detection_source, i.memo, i.checked_at, c.location, c.check_date, d.department_name FROM safety_check_item i JOIN safety_checklist c ON c.checklist_id = i.checklist_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = c.department_id WHERE i.helmet_worn = 0 OR i.chin_strap_fastened = 0 OR i.is_damaged = 1 OR i.is_expired = 1 ORDER BY i.checked_at DESC, i.item_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
